definitions.explanation: the bumpy texture of skin caused by cold or strong emotions

examples.japanese: {寒|さむ}くて{鳥肌|とりはだ}が{立|た}った。
examples.english: I got goosebumps from the cold.

examples.japanese: {感動|かんどう}して{鳥肌|とりはだ}が{立|た}った。
examples.english: I got goosebumps from being moved.

examples.japanese: あの{歌|うた}を{聞|き}くと{鳥肌|とりはだ}が{立|た}つほど{感動|かんどう}する。
examples.english: That song is so moving it gives me goosebumps.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{鳥肌|とりはだ} literally means "bird skin" ({鳥|とり} = bird, {肌|はだ} = skin), referring to the appearance of plucked poultry.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {鳥肌|とりはだ}が{立|た}つ - to get goosebumps (the standard collocation)
- {鳥肌|とりはだ}もの - something that gives you goosebumps (often describing something amazing or creepy)

CAUSES:
{鳥肌|とりはだ} can be caused by:
- Cold temperatures ({寒|さむ}さ)
- Fear ({恐怖|きょうふ})
- Emotional experiences ({感動|かんどう})
- Creepy or eerie situations ({気味|きみ}が{悪|わる}い)

RELATED:
- {身震|みぶる}い - shiver, shudder
- {寒気|さむけ} - chills
